book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.ar: سافرنا لأوروبا وهولمز كان يتطلع ورا كل شوي.
sentences.en: We travelled to Europe and Holmes kept looking behind him.
At every station he changed the plan.

sentences.ar: قال لي: أنا مش خايف على حالي.
sentences.en: He said to me: I am not afraid for myself.

sentences.ar: لو انتهت هالقصة، بكون عملت أهم إشي بحياتي.
sentences.en: If this ends, I will have done the most important thing of my life.

sentences.ar: وصلنا سويسرا، ومشينا لعند شلال كبير.
sentences.en: We reached Switzerland, and walked to a great waterfall.

sentences.ar: الصوت كان عالي والبخار طالع من تحت.
sentences.en: The sound was loud and the spray rose from below.
